headline: Loyal Textile Mills Files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Loyal Textile Mills Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) of the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signaling a substantial shareholding change or acquisition trigger reportable to the stock exchange.
detail: Loyal Textile Mills Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE pursuant to SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. The filing was deposited in NSE archives on 19 Jun 2026. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of material information regarding acquisitions exceeding prescribed thresholds within a strict timeline, and the filing initiates the regulatory approval and public dissemination process. Specific details of the acquirer, consideration, and shareholding percentage are contained in the linked regulatory document.
